configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Builds Filo with everything it can find. PDF extraction and semantic search switch themselves off when PDFIUM_ROOT and LLAMA_ROOT are not set, so this configures on a machine that has neither.

configurePresets.name: full
configurePresets.description: Everything on. Expects PDFIUM_ROOT and LLAMA_ROOT in the environment, or passed with -D. See the readme for how to build those two.
